messages:
owen: Hey folks, quick question9/12-9/16 Trip to Tokyo. Can I claim per-diem for meals and also get reimbursed for client dinner that exceeds per-diem? Also booking hotel on personal card.

maria - People Ops: Hi @owen :wave: per-diem covers your personal meals up to the daily cap; you don't need meal receipts for amounts within per-diem. For client dinners that exceed per-diem, use expense type 'Meals - Client Entertainment' and attach the itemized receipt plus attendees and company names. Lodging must have receipt/folio even if on a personal card.

owen: thanks. What about foreign currency receipts and exchange rates?

lee (Finance): good Q. Upload the original foreign-currency receipt and the card statement line showing the card charge. Ramp will auto-convert but include the bank's exchange rate screenshot if you want Finance to use that instead. For per-diem advances, we'll issue USD equivalent based on the date of payment.

owen: lost a taxi receipt 9/13 9 is that a problem?

maria - People Ops: If it's under $75 we accept a signed missing-receipt memo (one sentence explaining vendor/date/amount and manager sign-off). Over $75 requires vendor outreach or vendor invoice.

expense-bot: Automated: Travel advance requests require manager approval. Missing manager approval will pause processing.

tess: FWIW I booked a hotel on my card in Seoul last month. Finance asked for the folio + the card statement line; they reimbursed within 8 business days after I uploaded everything to Ramp and noted the advance amount.

owen: great, i'll submit the Travel Advance form and attach the hotel folio and itinerary. tagging @maria for expedite if needed. :thumbsup:
